profile.goodFor: echoes: slapback on vocals, rhythmic delays in time with the song, wide stereo echoes on a send

settings.name: Note
settings.what: the echo time in note lengths, when synced to the tempo

settings.name: Feedback
settings.what: how many times it repeats: more is longer

settings.name: Mix
settings.what: dry to echoes; 100% on a send bus

settings.name: Sync
settings.what: echo time following the song's tempo, or free in ms

settings.name: Time
settings.what: the echo time in ms, when free

settings.name: High cut
settings.what: darkens the echoes so they sit behind the sound

settings.name: Low cut
settings.what: thins the echoes so they don't muddy the lows

settings.name: Mode
settings.what: stereo, ping-pong between sides, or mono echoes
